mentions.name: Symbiote workout app (beta)
mentions.description: This Android-only beta workout app offers Alpha Progression or MacroFactor Workout-like Smart Progression and lets users run any training program, similar to Boostcamp, but without ads or subscriptions.
mentions.problem: Comparable workout apps are ad- and subscription-based.
mentions.source_excerpt:
If you are looking for a workout app with Alpha Progression or MacroFactor Workout-like “Smart Progression,” or an app where you can run any program like Boostcamp but ad- and subscription-free, check out the Symbiote workout app (beta)
https://symbiote-studio.macrocodex.app/
